description:
Yerak, the land where the king with Yeouiju in his heart rules with the dragon. And the royal family, 'Mani', who has to offer her heart to the Crown Prince. 'Mani' is forced to stay in her palace until death. This generation's 'Mani', Yuri Seoran,   
makes an oath with her Kyoryong with three absolute orders in exchange for his freedom. 

"What's your name?" "It’s Yeoul." "I'll make sure you don't regret becoming my dragon."

As her first order, Yeoul leaves to see the outside world in exchange to write letters describing what he sees.
